set.body: Add the first statistically useful result surface. Deliverables: beta/residual-variance/diagnostic containers, standard errors from OLS covariance, t-contrast evaluation aligned by column name, and contrast result containers preserving voxel indices and predictor names. Acceptance: known-design tests verify beta, standard error, t statistic, df, residual variance, and contrast name alignment on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Slice 3: OLS inference and contrasts
